name: conclave
description: Personal multi-model agent harness: one server, many models, persistent memory, every device.

scripts.build: bun run --filter @conclave/web build && bun run --filter @conclave/cli build
scripts.test: bun test packages/core packages/server packages/cli scripts/proxmox scripts/lxc scripts/releases scripts/check-styles.test.ts bench/test/model-parity.test.ts packages/web/test/composer-draft.test.tsx
scripts.typecheck: bunx tsc -p packages/core --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/cli --noEmit
